graders.name: checklist-unchanged
graders.pattern:
^\#\ Release\ checklist

\#\#\ Before\ tagging

\-\ Update\ `CHANGELOG\.md`\ with\ every\ merged\ pull\ request\ since\ the\ last\ tag\.
\-\ Bump\ the\ version\ in\ `package\.json`\.

\#\#\ Rollback

1\.\ Run\ `deploy\.sh\ production\ \-\-version\ <previous\ tag>`\.
2\.\ Confirm\ the\ health\ check\ at\ `/healthz`\ returns\ 200\.
3\.\ Open\ an\ incident\ issue\ labelled\ `release\-rollback`\.
$
graders.description: The checklist reference is byte-for-byte unchanged.

graders.name: keeps-failed-step-report
graders.description: The instruction to report the failed step survives.

graders.name: keeps-rollback-section
graders.description: The Rollback section is still named.

graders.name: no-markdown-link
graders.description: No pointer is written as a Markdown link; each is a plain path, with any section named in prose.

graders.name: pointers-plain
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `skills/release/SKILL.md`. The original pointed to `references/checklist.md` with Markdown links, one of them a section name followed by a link to the same section ("the Rollback section ([Rollback](references/checklist.md#rollback))"). Pass only if each pointer now names its target once: a plain path such as `references/checklist.md`, with the Rollback section named in prose, and no Markdown link, `#anchor`, or section title repeated as link text. Everything else must survive with its meaning: confirm `main` is green in CI or stop and report the failing job; work through the checklist before tagging; `git tag vX.Y.Z` and push the tag; `deploy.sh production`; on a failed deploy, follow the Rollback section and tell the user which step failed; the checklist is never skipped. Fail if any of these is lost or changed.
